Old Faithful's next eruption came 54 to 79 minutes after the preceding one in these four observations.

```image
src: media/old-faithful.jpg
alt: Old Faithful erupting in front of visitors on the viewing boardwalk
caption: Old Faithful in eruption, October 2019. National Park Service photograph by Jim Peaco.
width: 1344
height: 872
```

*Source: [the Old Faithful photograph and its credit](https://richview.ai/docs/gallery/same-numbers/), National Park Service, public domain.*
